content: The morning cloud becomes the wing of the evening sunset.
author: Japanese Proverbs
explanation: The heavy, gray mist that obscures your morning path is the exact moisture that catches the golden rays at twilight, creating a glorious crimson sky. The sorrows and fog of your youth become the luminous depth of your elder years.
practicalInsight: When your morning begins under a dark emotional cloud, remember that this gray steam will fuel the fiery sunset of your eventual triumph.
reflectionPrompt: How can you view your present challenges as the raw pigment of your future wisdom?
